name: The Curious Elf
source:
A human man and elf woman meet for their monthly hookup deep in the forest and find an unexpected surprise.  They love each-other and are a secret couple because of the human vs elf prejudices of their world.

[From [url=https://ortus.itch.io/the-curious-elf]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
人类男人和精灵女人在森林深处进行每月一次的勾搭，并发现了意想不到的惊喜。由于他们的世界中存在人类与精灵的偏见，他们彼此相爱，并且是一对秘密情侣。

[来自[url=https://ortus.itch.io/the-curious-elf]Itch.io[/url]]
